papers.title: A depth-dependent, transverse shift-invariant operator for fast iterative 3D photoacoustic tomography in planar geometry
papers.summary: Depth-indexed FFT-based forward and adjoint operators for planar 3D PAT; reports up to two orders of magnitude acceleration in iterative reconstruction on experimental all-optical datasets.

papers.title: Resolving Acoustic Temporal Aliasing in High-Throughput Photoacoustic Microscopy Through Spatial Division Multiplexing
papers.category: Photoacoustic Imaging / Coded and Multiplexed Acquisition
papers.summary: Spatial-division multiplexed photoacoustic microscopy to avoid acoustic temporal aliasing; reports equivalent 6 MHz pulse repetition rate and 4-fold spatial-bandwidth-product improvement.
